versions.description_html:
Learn what Power Automate Desktop is, how desktop vs cloud flows work, recording actions, attended vs unattended modes, pricing, and where flows break.

Power Automate Desktop is a free robot already sitting on your Windows PC, and most people never switch it on. It's Microsoft's answer to work you do the same way, over and over, in apps that were never built to talk to anything else.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Power Automate Desktop Actually Is
  • Desktop Flows Versus Cloud Flows
  • How the Recorder Turns Your Clicks Into Actions
  • Attended Versus Unattended
  • Connecting Desktop Flows to Cloud Flows
  • What It Costs
  • What People Actually Use It For
  • Where It Breaks
  • The Recap

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM

  • Power Automate - Simply Explained
  • Power Automate vs Azure Logic Apps for Scalable Workflows
  • More Power Platform episodes on M365.FM
